about: Vitruvian Manager’s own index of the companies, organisations and ships on official sanctions lists. A person is never indexed: every record a list types as an individual is dropped before anything is written. Written by osint/scripts/build-sanctions.mjs; never edited by hand. For learning, not a compliance check: the lists change daily, and the official list decides.

eu.name: EU consolidated list of financial sanctions
eu.termsQuote: The official catalogue record labels this file “Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International”.
eu.credit: Contains data from the EU consolidated list of financial sanctions, © European Union, under CC BY 4.0. Vitruvian Manager kept the names, types, programmes, cited acts, references, countries and IMO numbers of the enterprises only.
eu.listedMeaning: This file gives no date of listing; it names the legal act the list cites for the entry, and that act’s date of publication.

uk.name: UK Sanctions List
uk.termsQuote: gov.uk: “All content is available under the Open Government Licence v3.0, except where otherwise stated”.
uk.credit: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Vitruvian Manager kept the names, types, regimes, designation dates, references, countries, IMO numbers and flags of the entities and ships only.
uk.listedMeaning: The date the UK designated it, as the list gives it.
